_about: The five shapes a Tamed Island can be, chosen once at character creation and permanent (spec 29 section 4, PRD 4.2, docs/reference/durango-domain-tamed-island-select.webp). 'seed' drives the IslandShape landmass (coast, highlands, river), so each shape is a different island; 'terrain' picks the home island's scatter row (game/data/islands/home_grassland.json 'terrains'); 'accent' is the preview card's land tint. The first row is the pre-ISLANDPICK island (seed 17, the legacy core) so a fresh meadow pick and an old save build the same ground.
